description: Zero-runtime SVG area chart for offline dashboards; does not require window.Chart or Chart.js.

fragments.emmet: div[data-component=svg-area-chart][data-slot=chart]>svg.w-full[role=img][aria-label='Total visitors area chart']>title{Total visitors}+desc{Area series for desktop and mobile visitors.}+path[data-series=desktop][fill=currentColor]+path[data-series=mobile][fill=currentColor]
